other.note: Cover Fossil: Mirage Tower on Route 111 (appears on about half of your visits; pick one fossil), or the Desert Underpass after the Hall of Fame
Plume Fossil: the other one of the pair (Mirage Tower pick, or the Desert Underpass after the Hall of Fame). Take one at the tower and the Underpass gives you the other, so you always get both
Old Amber: item ball in New Mauville
Sail Fossil: item ball on Abandoned Ship B1F
Frost Fossil: item ball in Shoal Cave (low-tide stairs room)
1,500 coins each (Zorua 2,000). One of each per save; on a Nuzlocke the prize is your Mauville encounter
9,999 coins each: the Ultra Beasts, hinted at by the woman near the counter
From the first badge; 1 in 20 per TV check; lasts a day
Blocks the path near the bridge
After the Hall of Fame: 10% on its route, always 2 levels above the route's highest wild Pokémon. Lead with a Pokémon at that level and use a Repel: only the starter can appear.
Roam after the Hall of Fame (TV news); flee on turn one
